newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Amper had net through May of 2.39 bln pta.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Amper had net through May of 2.39 bln pta.

text.p: Spanish phone equipment firm Amper said on Thursday its net group profit from January to May rose 57 percent to 2.39 billion pesetas, but added it expects to end 1997 with profit and sales at levels close to 1996.

According to a speech by group chief executive Eugenio Vela read to a shareholders meeting, the group would pay its final dividend on July 3, while the already-announced nominal cut would be effected in October.
In 1996, Amper had net profit of 9.18 billion pesetas, three times higher than in 1995 thanks to extraordinary results from stakes sales to German group Siemens.
Amper's final dividend will be 45 pesetas gross per share for a total 1996 dividend of 85 pesetas per share.
The board added that the reduction in the face value of shares to 300 pesetas from current 500 pesetas will take place in the first week of October.
